rules.rationale: The merge records branch integration topology. Its resulting files are covered by the frozen final-A13 file comparison, while each non-merge product patch has a separate ledger entry and disposition.
rules.necessity: The final merged state is necessary; replaying the historical merge object itself across Android releases is neither required nor meaningful.
rules.performance: No target runtime cost; this is a provenance and parent-mapping disposition.
rules.security: No merge commit is used to waive a final-file mismatch; security-relevant final content remains assigned to the patch and file evidence entries.
validation_evidence: Both merge parents are preserved in this ledger entry and the audit compares the resulting final A13 component tree against Android 16.

rules.rationale: The patch has no surviving semantic delta in the frozen final A13 component tree, so replaying it would restore behavior that the A13 development line itself removed.
rules.necessity: Not necessary at the authoritative A13 head; final-state equivalence requires preserving the later A13 result.
rules.performance: No target runtime or build cost because the superseded intermediate state is not reintroduced.
rules.security: Avoids reviving intermediate policy, service, translator, graphics, audio, camera, or property behavior that is absent from the final authority state.
validation_evidence: Coverage audit found either only superseded final-file evidence or no surviving final-tree delta.

decisions.rationale: The A13 taskbar-presence gate is implemented at the Android 16 TaskbarManagerImpl enablement point with the same bst.hide_taskbar contract.
decisions.necessity: Required to keep the guest taskbar hidden by default while allowing an explicit product property to enable it.
decisions.performance: One property read when taskbar enablement is evaluated; no polling or per-frame work.
decisions.security: No new privilege or IPC surface.
validation_evidence: A13 and Android 16 hunks reviewed side by side; focused Launcher runtime regression remains pending.

decisions.rationale: Both Launcher3 manifests relinquish HOME ownership and OverviewComponentObserver uses explicit Quickstep and uncube components with null-safe Android 16 configuration handling.
decisions.necessity: Required so com.uncube.launcher3 is the product HOME while Launcher3 remains the Recents provider.
decisions.performance: No hot-path cost; component selection occurs during overview target resolution.
decisions.security: Changes default-home routing but introduces no exported component or permission bypass.
validation_evidence: A13 and Android 16 manifest/observer hunks reviewed side by side; clean-Data HOME selection regression remains pending.

decisions.rationale: The A13 TaskView Java host launch-policy call is preserved in the Android 16 Kotlin TaskView, with null and RuntimeException fail-open handling.
decisions.necessity: Required for host policy to veto launches selected from Recents.
decisions.performance: One existing-system-service lookup and one binder call per clicked recent task.
decisions.security: The A16 adaptation is narrower and safer than A13 because unavailable host policy fails open without crashing Launcher3.
validation_evidence: A13 Java and Android 16 Kotlin launch paths reviewed side by side; host-policy runtime regression remains pending.

decisions.rationale: RecentsActivity resets the last host mouse action when returning to the default Recents state, using the Android 16 helper executor and clearing the property only after host success.
decisions.necessity: Required to avoid a stale per-app mouse action preventing normal interaction after closing an app from Recents.
decisions.performance: At most one asynchronous binder call for each non-empty pending mouse action.
decisions.security: No new endpoint; the A16 adaptation catches host-call failures and avoids blocking the UI thread.
validation_evidence: A13 and Android 16 Recents state transitions reviewed side by side; close-app and mouse-action runtime regression remains pending.
